vectors.name: valid_user_token
vectors.description: a token for this service, project and permission

vectors.name: valid_service_account_token
vectors.description: a Service Account token is verified like a user token

vectors.name: expired
vectors.description: exp is past by more than the skew

vectors.name: within_skew
vectors.description: exp is past by less than the skew of 60 seconds

vectors.name: not_yet_valid
vectors.description: nbf lies in the future by more than the skew

vectors.name: wrong_audience
vectors.description: the token is for another service

vectors.name: two_audiences
vectors.description: a token with more than one audience is refused even if this service is one of them

vectors.name: wrong_issuer
vectors.description: iss is not the issuer of NICE

vectors.name: alg_none
vectors.description: an unsigned token

vectors.name: alg_hs256
vectors.description: a token signed with HMAC; only RS256 is allowed

vectors.name: unknown_kid
vectors.description: signed by a key that is not in the JWKS

vectors.name: bad_signature
vectors.description: the payload was changed after signing

vectors.name: malformed
vectors.description: not a JWT

vectors.name: missing_token
vectors.description: no Authorization header

vectors.name: permission_missing
vectors.description: the token does not hold the permission the operation needs

vectors.name: project_mismatch
vectors.description: the request names another project than the token

vectors.name: project_matches
vectors.description: the request names the project of the token

vectors.name: stale_principal
vectors.description: the principal was disabled after the token was issued

vectors.name: issued_after_change
vectors.description: the change is older than the token

vectors.name: stale_organization
vectors.description: the organization was suspended after the token was issued

vectors.name: stale_project
vectors.description: the project changed after the token was issued

vectors.name: change_of_another_principal
vectors.description: a change concerning someone else does not touch this token

vectors.name: change_in_another_organization
vectors.description: a change of the same principal in another organization does not touch this token

vectors.name: sensitive_allowed
vectors.description: a sensitive operation passes when the online check allows it

vectors.name: sensitive_denied
vectors.description: a sensitive operation is refused when the online check denies it

vectors.name: sensitive_check_down
vectors.description: a sensitive operation fails closed when NICE cannot be reached

vectors.name: organization_rejected
vectors.description: the service accepts only the organizations on its list

vectors.name: organization_listed
vectors.description: the organization is on the list of the service

vectors.name: organization_created_on_first_use
vectors.description: a service that creates tenants on first use accepts a new organization

vectors.name: tenant_from_client_ignored
vectors.description: the tenant is the organization of the token, never what the client asks for

vectors.name: valid_exchanged_token
vectors.description: a token a service backend got by token exchange: accepted like any other, the handler sees the user as subject and act.sub as actor

vectors.name: expired_exchanged_token
vectors.description: a token from a token exchange whose exp is past is refused for its expiry, act changes nothing

vectors.name: valid_act_as_token
vectors.description: a token of a platform operator acting in an organization it is not a member of: accepted like any other, the handler sees nice_act_as

vectors.name: stale_act_as_operator
vectors.description: a token act-as is stale after a change of its principal in the organization nice_act_as names

vectors.name: change_in_platform_without_act_as
vectors.description: a change of the principal in the platform organization does not touch a token without nice_act_as

vectors.name: lifetime_exceeds_ttl
vectors.description: the token lives longer than the TTL plus the skew: a change that revoked it would be forgotten before it expires

vectors.name: missing_iat
vectors.description: a token without iat: its lifetime cannot be checked

vectors.name: stale_same_second_by_policy_version
vectors.description: the change came in the second the token was issued, with a higher policy version than pv

vectors.name: issued_after_change_same_second
vectors.description: the token was issued after the change, in the same second: pv equals the version of the change

vectors.name: policy_version_other_org
vectors.description: a higher policy version of another organization does not touch the token

vectors.name: stale_act_as_same_second
vectors.description: the operator role was removed in the platform organization in the second the token act-as was issued

vectors.name: stale_without_pv
vectors.description: a token without pv is judged by the second it was issued

vectors.name: same_second_without_pv
vectors.description: a token without pv of the second of the change is not refused: only pv can order them

vectors.name: perms_ref_resolved
vectors.description: a token that carries perms_ref instead of perms: the list NICE resolves it to holds the permission

vectors.name: perms_ref_permission_missing
vectors.description: the list perms_ref names does not hold the permission the operation needs

vectors.name: perms_ref_mismatch
vectors.description: NICE says perms_ref no longer matches the permissions of the principal: the token is stale

vectors.name: perms_ref_resolution_down
vectors.description: perms_ref is not known and NICE cannot be reached: the request fails closed

vectors.name: perms_ref_other_list
vectors.description: the answer holds a list whose reference is not perms_ref: it is not used, even though it holds the permission

vectors.name: perms_and_perms_ref
vectors.description: a token that carries both perms and perms_ref says its permissions twice and is refused
